name: codex-ecc-repo-audit
description: Parallel audit of the codex-ecc-custom repository across security, architecture, and skill-consistency dimensions with a human gate before deploying fixes
diagram:
```mermaid
graph TD
  Plan[plan-audit] --> Sec[audit-security]
  Plan --> Arch[audit-architecture]
  Plan --> Skill[audit-skill-consistency]
  Sec --> Syn[synthesize-findings]
  Arch --> Syn
  Skill --> Syn
  Syn --> Gate[human-gate-deploy]
```

nodes.responsibility: Map the codex-ecc-custom repository structure and define audit scope for each dimension
Audit the repository for hardcoded secrets, exposed API keys, and insecure file permissions
Audit the skill directory structure for consistency, missing schemas, and broken references
Audit all skills for cross-IDE compatibility metadata and validation-rules.json presence
Check whether all three audit outputs cover their stated scope without missing critical areas
review_questions: Do all three audit outputs cover their stated scope completely without missing critical areas?

nodes.responsibility: Merge the three audit dimension findings into one prioritized remediation report
Human reviews the merged audit report and approves which fixes to deploy

edges.dependency_reason: Security auditor needs the repo map to know which files to scan for secrets
Architecture auditor needs the repo map to know which skill directories to inspect
Consistency auditor needs the repo map to know which skills to check for IDE metadata
Synthesizer needs all three dimension findings to produce a merged report
Synthesizer needs all three dimension findings to produce a merged report
Synthesizer needs all three dimension findings to produce a merged report
Reviewer needs all audit outputs to check scope coverage
Reviewer needs all audit outputs to check scope coverage
Reviewer needs all audit outputs to check scope coverage
Synthesizer needs the completeness review report before prioritizing remediation findings
Failed completeness review routes feedback back to the security auditor for re-investigation
Failed completeness review routes feedback back to the architecture auditor for re-investigation
Failed completeness review routes feedback back to the consistency auditor for re-investigation
Human needs the merged report to decide which fixes to approve for deployment
